desc:
This game is based on Hide and Seek from the game Among Us

I made this because I was getting tired of working on some other things.

Hide and Seek works where Crewmates must avoid and hide from the Imposter to win. By completing tasks, they can reduce the time which can allow them to win faster. The imposter can win when all Crewmates are eliminated.

All current tasks are placeholders. This game is mostly for testing and will be changed and updated.

The imposter is chosen at random.
